problem.title: Quality breaks down when it depends on memory, improvisation or manual follow-up.
problem.description: In many hotels, operations rely on spreadsheets, screenshots, messages and late reports. The result is not just chaos — it's loss of control.
points: Paper audits, loose checklists or spreadsheets that nobody updates on time.
Recurring findings because there is no real follow-up or clear ownership.
Middle managers making decisions with partial information and no traceability.
Teams misaligned between operations, quality and training when a deviation appears.

solution.title: ServiceControl turns hotel quality into an operating system.
solution.description: It's not just about auditing. It's about detecting, assigning, training and verifying with a single platform that gives continuity to every deviation.
solution.pillar1Title: One central system to execute, correct and verify.
solution.pillar1Description: ServiceControl connects audits, area scoring, corrective actions, re-audits and training in the same operational workflow.
solution.pillar2Title: Every deviation is recorded with context and follow-up.
solution.pillar2Description: Management and operations see the real state of the hotel, at-risk areas and team progress without chasing manual reports.
features: Digital audits with evidence and score by area
Re-audits to confirm the problem was actually fixed
Corrective actions with owners and visible progress tracking
Training linked to real team deviations

benefits.title: Less operational chaos. More reaction capacity and control.
benefits.description: The platform is designed so that management, operations and quality all work from the same picture of the hotel and can act before a deviation becomes the norm.
items: Catch failures before they reach the guest or escalate to an incident.
Improve daily execution with clear standards and concrete follow-up.
Turn quality into a measurable system, not a one-off review.
Reduce the chaos of WhatsApp, paper and loose sheets to coordinate operations.

trust.title: Built on the standards you already work with.
trust.description: ServiceControl is not a generic checklist tool adapted to hotels. It is designed from the ground up around the real structure of a luxury property: areas, shifts, roles and the level of demand of international inspections.

items.title: Compatible with your inspection standards
items.body: Configure your templates on Forbes Travel Guide criteria, LHW standards or your own brand manual. The standard you are inspected against is the standard you audit every day.

items.title: Your data, protected like your reputation
items.body: Data hosted in the European Union, encryption in transit and at rest, role-based access and GDPR compliance. Your operation's information is never shared between properties.

items.title: Made by and for hotel operators
items.body: Every workflow — audit, corrective action, re-audit, training — mirrors how a hotel actually runs, not how office software imagines it.

items.title: Guided implementation, in your language
items.body: Areas, standards and teams configured together with our team, in Spanish or English, on your real operation. Up and running in days, not months.

facts: 100% of findings with an owner and a due date
Sandbox up and running in under 1 minute
Executive report in real time, not at month-end

scenarios.title: Three management roles, the same problem: knowing if the standard is being met today.
scenarios.description: Illustrative scenarios of how a hotel works with ServiceControl day to day.

items.title: The Thursday committee without building the report the night before.
items.body: Open the dashboard before the meeting: score by area, open deviations and their age, this week's re-audits. When ownership asks about housekeeping, the answer is not a feeling — it's a 12-month trend.

items.title: Four thousand keys, nine restaurants, and knowing what fails without walking it all.
items.body: Each supervisor audits their zone from mobile, with photo and timestamp. Deviations route themselves to the right department — maintenance sees theirs, housekeeping theirs — and nothing closes until the re-audit confirms it.

items.role: Quality Management · Beach resort · Los Cabos
items.title: Walking into the inspection already knowing the result.
items.body: The inspection's standards live as audit templates executed every week. Six weeks before the visit, the history shows which areas pass consistently and which need training — not a hunch, a data point per standard.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.permanencia_a: No. Monthly plans can be cancelled at any time. With the annual plan you invoice the full year upfront in exchange for −15%.
faq.config_q: Does the price include initial setup?
faq.config_a: The first configuration (areas, templates, users) is done in a guided session included in all plans. A more extensive implementation or data migration is agreed separately.
faq.multihotel_q: What if we have more than one hotel?
faq.multihotel_a: Any plan can be extended with additional properties at a preferential rate. We also have a multi-property panel to compare results across properties.
faq.cambio_a: Yes. You can upgrade or downgrade at any time. When switching to annual, the remaining time on the current month is prorated.
faq.instalar_q: Do I need to install anything?
faq.instalar_a: No. ServiceControl is 100% web-based and works from any device — the team can audit from mobile and management can view dashboards from desktop.
faq.datos_a: Yes. Data is stored on European servers (EU-West), with daily backups, encryption in transit and at rest, and role-based access. We can sign a DPA if your organization requires it.
